body: Chief on P0-2 candidate 41ebdb8: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS — all six block items verified closed at file:line by the fresh-context re-review with new probes (sealed ReceiptDigest with private[embed] Plain/Keyed/Withheld; ItemDigest refuses Plain for non-Public; no Plain fallback — key-once probe yields Withheld with zero provider calls in baselines; KeyUnavailable recorded; keyId derived; one ReceiptRendering with 9 adversarial delimiter texts distinct; golden hashes the production rendering; typed kind through Embedder.embed and CachingEmbedder; PseudonymizedText mints its Keyed digest at construction — the evaluate deviation is sound, denial is strictly earlier). My run: embed-core 72/72 JVM+JS, interview 23, embed-grakern 20. REQUIRED before merge (two mediums, both on the invariant the bead exists for): (1) cache.scala:101-118 delegates to the underlying embedder and puts (121-127) BEFORE the attempt-level key check (148-157) — probe (attempt key available once, inner keyed): receipt Withheld but providerCalls=1 and cacheSize=1, outcome rewritten to key-unavailable; this contradicts receipt.scala:200-201 and ADR D6 ('Withheld never describes a provider call') and leaves a cached vector for a denied outcome. Fix: resolve keys.key(keys.currentKeyId) once at batch start and fail closed before delegating; defer puts until the receipt is minted. (2) AttemptReceipt.public (contract.scala:254-262) takes no sensitivity evidence — a Keyed baseline result re-receipted via .public yields kind=Plain/itemSensitivity=0; make it private[embed] or take the EmbedBatch/itemSensitivity and return Either. LOW (fold in if cheap, else follow-up notes on the bead): AttemptReceipt holds a live key provider (contract.scala:137) — pass keys into addResultDecisions; on key loss addResultDecisions withholds but keeps vectors in outcomes (unlike the cache path) — align them; EmbedError.NoKey should carry KeyId not String (baselines:61, cache:83); PolicyDenied now admits Allowed; PseudonymizedText.digest could be typed Keyed. Repost the SHA + 3-platform embed-core evidence; I re-run and land; W3 and P1-1 slice 2 rebase on it.
